source_document.name: Projects_Lookbook.pdf
source_document.important_note: The Lookbook states that listed dimensions are best approximations and that product specifications may change.

data_policy.real_product_data: Product names, SKUs, listed prices and printed dimensions in this JSON come from the supplied Kohler Projects Lookbook.
data_policy.dimension_policy: Published product dimensions are converted from mm to inches without changing the underlying measurements. A null dimension means the Lookbook did not provide that dimension for that SKU.
data_policy.planning_fallback_policy: When a product-specific spatial dimension is unavailable, Stage A must use the separate category_spatial_rules object rather than silently treating a category proxy as a Kohler product specification.
derived_fields: material when category-level inference is used

material_policy.purpose: Populate material fields for Stage B aesthetic reasoning without presenting inferred category materials as SKU-verified Kohler specifications.
material_policy.product_verified_material: Only used when the exact SKU/product page or supplied Lookbook explicitly supports the material.
material_policy.category_level_inference: Used when the supplied Lookbook does not specify SKU-level material. These values are planning/aesthetic inference, not product-spec claims.
material_policy.web_enrichment_note: Kohler India product pages and Kohler material/manufacturing guidance were consulted to improve material coverage where the supplied Lookbook lacked SKU-level material.

washbasin.source: NKBA Bathroom Planning Guideline 4 and Single-Lavatory Placement

toilet.source: NKBA Bathroom Planning Guideline 4 / Toilet-Bidet Placement

vanity.note: Do not label the 36 × 21 proxy as a Kohler vanity dimension. Replace it with actual SKU dimensions when a vanity specification is supplied.
vanity.source: NKBA clear-space guidance; 21-inch depth is a common planning proxy, not a Kohler specification.

shower_enclosure.note: The Lookbook confirms Kohler offers shower enclosures but does not provide SKU-level enclosure dimensions in the supplied pages. The 36 × 36 proxy is therefore not a Kohler product dimension.

mirror.spatial_rule: Use wall dimensions only; do not subtract mirror dimensions from floor area.

bathroom_faucet.spatial_rule: Treat as a fixture mounted on/through a basin or wall; its dimensions should not be counted as floor footprint.

shower_fixture.spatial_rule: Treat showerhead/rainhead dimensions as overhead/wall fixture dimensions, while the shower enclosure itself consumes floor area.

stage_a_engine_notes: Never substitute a category planning proxy into dimensions_in.
For toilet and basin fit, use product footprint first and clearance rules second.
For vanity and shower enclosure, use category planning proxies only until actual SKU dimensions are supplied.
Mirrors, faucets and showerheads should not be treated as floor-footprint obstacles.
Keep original Kohler SKU and source dimensions so every spatial number can be traced back to the Lookbook.
A product with missing height can still be used for 2D floor-fit checks because width × depth are the relevant footprint dimensions.

stage_b_material_notes: Material is now available to the aesthetic reasoning layer for all 38 catalog products.
Do not treat category-level inferred material as a SKU specification.
Use material_confidence and material_is_product_verified when deciding how strongly to rely on material in recommendations.

Vitreous china is especially useful for basin/toilet style reasoning; brass is useful for faucet coordination; mirror glass/metal and shower metal/polymer should be treated as secondary aesthetic signals.
The Lookbook explicitly supports HDHMR for Kohler vanities, but the current product list contains no vanity SKUs.
